name: Apart Ebene
beschreibung: The guesthouse Apart Ebene is located in the Ebene district of Ischgl. The valley station of the Silvretta Cable Car is within walking distance. The property combines comfortable guest rooms with holiday apartments. Traditional Tyrolean specialties are served in the on-site restaurant. A sauna area complements the amenities. The accommodation provides a convenient base for activities in both summer and winter. Parking facilities are available for a fee.
